set_light_temperature_k.description: Set the white color temperature of the lights in Kelvin.
examples: Set the white temperature to 5000K in the garage.

dim_light.description: Dim or brighten lights to a target brightness percentage.
examples: Could you set the hallway lights at 80% please?
Bring the garage lights down to 90%.

turn_on_light.description: Turn on the lights in a specified room.
examples: I need the living room lit up.
Switch on lighting in the kitchen.

set_light_color.description: Change the color of the lights in a room.
